Practical application over m7 chords: In practice, jazz musicians prefer using Dorian and Aeolian modes over m7 chords because they contain 0 or 1 avoid note. Locrian is reserved for half-diminished chords (m7b5) due to its b5, and Phrygian is reserved for Phrygian chords. Nguồn giảng bằng tiếng Anh, câu trên giữ nguyên lời giảng.
